achievements.name: File 01
achievements.detail: Clear the first story file and return to Neuron headquarters.

achievements.name: Sword Legion
achievements.detail: Bind the Sword Legion and fight a case with it.

achievements.name: Arrow Legion
achievements.detail: Unlock the Arrow Legion and bring it into a fight.

achievements.name: Beast Legion
achievements.detail: Unlock the Beast Legion and bring it into a fight.

achievements.name: Arm Legion
achievements.detail: Unlock the Arm Legion and bring it into a fight.

achievements.name: Sync Attack
achievements.detail: Finish a combo with a Sync Attack from your Legion.

achievements.name: Chain Bind
achievements.detail: Wrap an enemy in the chain so your Legion binds them.

achievements.name: Perfect Call
achievements.detail: Unlock Perfect Call on a Legion, then trigger it by calling that Legion just before an attack lands.

achievements.name: S Rank
achievements.detail: Earn an S rank or higher on a combat case played at Pt Standard or above.

achievements.name: Legion Skill
achievements.detail: Learn a skill in a Legion's learning tree and use that skill in battle.

achievements.name: Investigation
achievements.detail: Finish an optional investigation while you are out in the city.
